raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

On ROCm, `linear_bf16_fp32` (bf16 x bf16 -> fp32) runs `torch.mm(out_dtype=fp32)`, i.e. hipBLASLt. For the DeepSeek-V4 compressor `wkv_gate` (K=7168, N=1024 HCA / N=2560 fused CSA) that takes 11-16 us per call at decode sizes (M<=32), and a DSv4-Pro decode step makes 61 of these calls. ROCm/aiter#6005 makes the FlyDSL HGEMM fp32-accurate for fp32 output and adds tuned FlyDSL rows for these shapes (6-14 us).

## Modifications

- `kernels/ops/gemm/bf16_fp32.py`: on ROCm, `_linear_bf16_fp32_cublas` looks up aiter's tuned bf16 -> fp32 config for (M, N, K). If it is a FlyDSL row, it calls `aiter.tuned_gemm.tgemm.mm(x, w, otype=fp32)`. Otherwise it uses `torch.mm(out_dtype=fp32)` as before.
- Depends on ROCm/aiter#6005 for the fp32-accurate kernel and the DSv4 rows (M<=32 only; larger M stays on torch). Without it, none of the current callers' shapes has a FlyDSL fp32 row (the only ones on aiter main are N=6144, K=2048/3072), so everything stays on `torch.mm`. The same holds when aiter is not installed.

## Accuracy Tests

- DSv4 `wkv_gate` shapes (N=1024/2560, K=7168, M=1..112) vs fp64, 1x MI355X, image `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.20-rocm724-mi35x-20260927`:
  - stock aiter: never routed, output bitwise equal to `torch.mm`;
  - aiter + ROCm/aiter#6005: routed for M<=32, max rel err 2e-7..4e-7 (torch.mm 1e-7..5e-7); M>32 not routed, bitwise equal to `torch.mm`.
- `test/registered/kernels/ops/gemm/test_router_gemv_hip.py`: 2/2 pass, with and without ROCm/aiter#6005.
- DSv4-Pro TP8, DSpark (6 drafts), gsm8k 1319 questions, per boot: before 0.942 / 0.943, after 0.944 / 0.945.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Kernel, `wkv_gate` through `linear_bf16_fp32`, 1x MI355X, CUDA graph of 64 calls with 8 rotating weights, us per call:

| M | N=1024 torch.mm | N=1024 this PR | N=2560 torch.mm | N=2560 this PR |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 14.28 | 5.80 | 16.43 | 9.33 |
| 8 | 14.07 | 6.27 | 11.64 | 10.02 |
| 16 | 11.32 | 6.65 | 12.34 | 11.16 |
| 32 | 11.08 | 7.79 | 16.32 | 14.10 |
| 48 | 8.98 | 8.97 | 16.14 | 16.03 |

N=1024 M=1/8 come from the aiter tuning sweep (same timing method); the other cells time the sglang route.

E2E, DeepSeek-V4-Pro fp8, TP8 MI355X, image `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.20-rocm724-mi35x-20260927`, 8k in / 1k out, step time (ms). Before = image + our DSv4 decode stack: sgl-project/sglang#41383 (with ROCm/aiter#5882), sgl-project/sglang#38919 + sgl-project/sglang#38920 (`SGLANG_OPT_DSV4_C4_COMPRESSOR_GEMM_FUSION=1`), the DSpark verify ring write and the MoE small-batch sort. After = before + ROCm/aiter#6005 + this PR. Paired, 2 boots x 3 reps:

| cell | before | after | delta mean [min, max] |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| plain c8 | 12.22 | 11.88 | **-2.71%** [-0.365, -0.304 ms] |
| plain c32 | 15.79 | 15.62 | **-1.07%** [-0.195, -0.137 ms] |
| DSpark b6 c2 | 15.01 | 14.83 | **-1.14%** [-0.200, -0.127 ms] |
| DSpark b6 c4 | 17.60 | 17.39 | **-1.17%** [-0.258, -0.125 ms] |

All 24 pairs are faster. DSpark c16/c64 (M>32) are unchanged by construction.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

files.patch:
@@ -105,8 +105,35 @@ def hpc_bf16xfp32_gemm_enabled() -> bool:
     return _linear_bf16_fp32_algo == "hpc" and _hpc_gemm_bf16xfp32_available()
 
 
+@functools.cache
+def _aiter_tuned_gemm():
+    try:
+        from aiter.tuned_gemm import get_GEMM_A16W16_config, tgemm
+    except ImportError:
+        return None
+    return get_GEMM_A16W16_config, tgemm
+
+
+def _linear_bf16_fp32_aiter(x: torch.Tensor, y: torch.Tensor) -> Optional[torch.Tensor]:
+    """ROCm: the aiter FlyDSL fp32-out GEMM for shapes aiter has tuned for it
+    (e.g. the DSv4 compressor wkv_gate at decode sizes); None otherwise."""
+    fns = _aiter_tuned_gemm()
+    if fns is None or x.dim() != 2:
+        return None
+    get_config, tgemm = fns
+    m, k = x.shape
+    config = get_config(m, y.shape[0], k, False, "torch.bfloat16", "torch.float32")
+    if config is None or config.get("libtype") != "flydsl":
+        return None
+    return tgemm.mm(x, y, otype=torch.float32)
+
+
 def _linear_bf16_fp32_cublas(x: torch.Tensor, y: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
     if x.is_cuda and x.dtype == torch.bfloat16 and y.dtype == torch.bfloat16:
+        if torch.version.hip:
+            output = _linear_bf16_fp32_aiter(x, y)
+            if output is not None:
+                return output
         return torch.mm(x, y.t(), out_dtype=torch.float32)
     return torch.mm(x.float(), y.float().t())
